title: Pass around `digests.Options` in `PutBlobWithOptions`, implement digest choice for blobs on `dir:`
body:
This adds the `digests.Options` + `CannotChangeAlgorithmReason` to `PutBlobOptions`, and implements them for `dir:`.

That is immediately useful to show how digest conversions of configs fail, and as a template for a registry client work.

Other transports, when receiving non-SHA256 input, or asked to do non-SHA256 operations, will mostly fail. Some of them (oci/layout) should be quite easy to adapt, but that’s not on the critical path.

@alegrey91 PTAL
